metadata.change_reason: Architecture completeness and readiness review quality standard: 100% must-have coverage, one-vote veto, and zero placeholders

spec.name: Architecture Completeness & Readiness Review Quality Standard

rules.statement: All Must-Have requirements in the PRD must be 100% implemented and explicitly referenced in the architecture design (must_have_coverage_pct must be 100.0%)
Strictly enforce the one-vote veto rule: as long as any blocking_findings exist, ruling READY_FOR_DEV is strictly prohibited
Pending placeholders in review decisions and rationales are strictly prohibited
